exposure: causes of death reported in neonatal department
outcome: concordance between reported causes of death and fetopathologic examination findings
cohort: The study included all newborns admitted to the Neonatal Resuscitation Unit who died there before the 28th day of life and underwent a fetopathological examination.
finding: Total concordance between fetopathological and neonatological examinations was noted in 27% of cases, partial concordance in 40%, total discordance in 27%, and in 6% of cases the fetopathological examination showed no abnormalities.
